name: singlet_ambient_count_removal
title: Ambient RNA count removal
description: Removes the cell-free ambient RNA contribution from each cell's UMI counts and writes a corrected count layer plus per-cell removed-count estimates. Needs the droplet matrix including empty barcodes (raw/counts) and cell calls (obs/is_cell); optionally an ambient profile, cluster labels, per-cell contamination fractions or a gene mask. The default method cellbender is model-based and needs a GPU for practical run times, so call with dry_run first; decontx and soupx are fast CPU alternatives and scar is a PyTorch autoencoder. Do not use it to label individual UMIs as ambient, to decide which genes are contaminated, to remove index hopping between samples, or on data without empty droplets.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Correction method; options for the other methods are ignored.

keys.description: Names of the dataset members to read.

layer.description: Cell-level counts layer to correct; its genes and cells define the output.

cell.description: obs column of boolean cell calls.

ambient_profile.description: uns key of a precomputed ambient profile summing to one; when absent it is estimated from non-cell barcodes.

cluster.description: obs column of cluster labels; required for soupx unless contamination is set, optional for decontx.

contamination.description: obs column of per-cell contamination fractions from ambient.contamination_fraction; replaces the soupx estimate, ignored by other methods.

gene_mask.description: var boolean column; only true genes are corrected and the others are copied unchanged.

output_integer.description: Also write layers/decontaminated_int by unbiased stochastic rounding of the corrected counts.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for training and rounding; ignored by soupx.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

model.description: Noise model: ambient only, barcode swapping only, or both.

fpr.description: Target false-positive rate for signal removal; 0 for cohorts analysed jointly for differential expression.

learning_rate.description: Base learning rate; the OneCycle schedule peaks at ten times this value.

low_count_threshold.description: Barcodes with fewer UMIs are excluded from training.

delta.description: Dirichlet pseudocounts for native and contamination counts.

estimate_delta.description: Re-fit delta at every iteration by Dirichlet maximum likelihood.

convergence.description: Stop when the largest change in contamination proportions falls below this value.

var_genes.description: Variable genes used for internal clustering when keys.cluster is null.

tfidf_min.description: Minimum tf-idf of a marker gene.

soup_quantile.description: Only genes at or above this quantile of soup expression are used as markers.

max_markers.description: Maximum number of marker genes kept.

contamination_range.description: Lower and upper bound of the estimated contamination fraction.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/decontaminated and obs/ambient_removed_counts. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, device, profile_source, n_cells, n_genes_corrected, removed_fraction_median, removed_fraction_p90, fpr (cellbender), warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
